DECLARE @companyId int DECLARE @companyIDs table(companyId int) INSERT INTO @companyIDs VALUES (2),(13),(24),(33),(35),(38),(39),(40),(46),(48),(50),(52),(56),(57),(60),(70),(73),(87),(89), (93),(94),(98),(101),(102),(103),(109),(117),(118),(123),(130),(131),(133),(137),(147),(149),(150),(153), (154),(155),(157),(158),(166),(174),(178),(180),(181),(182),(183),(184),(185),(192),(203),(204),(208),(211),(216),(225), (227),(230),(231),(232),(238),(240),(250),(251),(252),(256),(261),(263),(265),(269);
DECLARE COMPANY_CURSOR CURSOR LOCAL STATIC READ_ONLY FORWARD_ONLY FOR SELECT DISTINCT CompanyId FROM @companyIDs OPEN COMPANY_CURSOR FETCH NEXT FROM COMPANY_CURSOR INTO @companyId WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CompanySetting WHERE CompanyID=@companyId AND SettingID=68) BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[CompanySetting] VALUES (@companyId, 68, '1') END FETCH NEXT FROM COMPANY_CURSOR INTO @companyId END CLOSE COMPANY_CURSOR DEALLOCATE COMPANY_CURSOR
